{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial troops' headquarters''' was an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] facility located on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Thisspias)/Legends|Imperial governor]] of Thisspias [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] the [[crown prince of Thisspias]] at the headquarters, although [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] eventually infiltrated the facility and liberated the [[Crown/Legends|crown]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
